steps.name: the address books
steps.sql: SELECT user_id, ab_type, data FROM address_books ORDER BY user_id, ab_type

steps.name: the metrics
steps.sql: SELECT peer_id, CAST(cpu_usage AS TEXT) AS cpu, CAST(memory_usage AS TEXT) AS memory, CAST(disk_usage AS TEXT) AS disk FROM peer_metrics ORDER BY id

steps.name: the devices online
steps.sql: SELECT id, status_online, is_banned, is_deleted, uuid, ip, "user", banned_reason, info, tags FROM peer ORDER BY id

steps.name: the system information
steps.sql: SELECT peer_id, hostname, username, platform, version, cpu_name, cpu_cores, CAST(cpu_freq_ghz AS TEXT) AS freq, CAST(memory_gb AS TEXT) AS memory, os_full, displays, encoding, features, platform_additions AS additions, raw_json AS raw FROM peer_sysinfo ORDER BY peer_id

steps.name: an hour old

steps.name: spread audit_connections in time
steps.sql: UPDATE audit_connections SET created_at = datetime('2001-01-01 00:00:00', '+' || id || ' minutes')

steps.name: spread audit_files in time

steps.name: spread audit_alarms in time

steps.name: the connection records
steps.sql: SELECT id, host_id, host_uuid, peer_id, peer_name, action, conn_type, session_id, ip FROM audit_connections ORDER BY id

steps.name: the file records
steps.sql: SELECT id, host_id, host_uuid, peer_id, direction, path, is_file, num_files, files_json AS files, ip, peer_name FROM audit_files ORDER BY id

steps.name: the alarm records
